content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Studies Applications Special cases Applying without a higher education entry qualification Applying without a higher education entry qualification Table of contents Requirements Applications Admission procedure Conditions Requirements Even if you do not have a higher education entry qualification, you may still be able to study at HTW Berlin under certain conditions. You require a recognised vocational qualification. Applications Please fill in the online application form of HTW Berlin. We will definitely require the following documents in case of enrolment: vocational training certificate (chamber of commerce and vocational school certificate) or vocational qualification certificate as a “Meister”, engineer, advanced vocational training. After sending your online application, you will be informed if you need to submit documents by the application deadline. Admission procedure As a rule, ten percent of the available study places on a study programme are allocated to vocationally qualified applicants. If you belong to this applicant group, you will only compete against other vocationally qualified applicants in the admission procedure. The average grade of your vocational training is the only deciding criterion. The better your average grade, the better your chances of securing a study place. Conditions If you have been granted admission with a special entry qualification, you will be subject to certain conditions.
